entities.summary: Grand Duke Vytautas (Witold) at the height of Lithuanian power. The Grand Duchy stretching from the Baltic to the Black Sea, the Council of Constance, the creation of the Samogitian diocese (1417), and Vytautas's failed bid for the Lithuanian crown.
